editorialNotes: Fishing quest cause fragments remain lowercase and compose after защото; catch counters retain their slash and placeholder roles.

The installed-game a/an split for size comparisons forces three leading-space and three no-leading fragments; the Bulgarian base supplies a neutral comparison and tolerates the source's harmless double space in the first group.
Item-delivery starters and purpose fragments were inspected in the installed-game generator and use това to avoid imposing grammatical gender on arbitrary item names.

corrections: Restored the source-required leading space on the baby-cow comparison fragment.
Rephrased the generic catch counter so arbitrary inserted fish names need no Bulgarian number or gender agreement.
